column1: 第一面 戰前 天狼
column4: 別踩到那條線。整片星圖都畫在石階上。
column5: Don't step on that line. The whole star chart is drawn across these steps.

column1: 第一面 戰前 天狼
column4: 星圖？村子上面的星星一顆都看不到，原來是被你搬到這裡來了！
column5: A star chart? Not one star is left over the village. So you dragged them all down here!

column1: 第一面 戰前 天狼
column4: 借而已。天門之夜以前，我得把它們讀完。
column5: Only borrowed. I have to finish reading them before the Night of the Heaven's Gate.

column1: 第一面 戰前 天狼
column4: 神社的婆婆說，沒有星星就定不了祭典的日子。你要借到什麼時候？
column5: The old lady at the shrine says we can't set the festival day without stars. How long are you keeping them?

column1: 第一面 戰前 天狼
column4: 讀完為止。
column5: Until I'm done.

column1: 第一面 戰前 天狼
column4: 那是多久！
column5: And how long is that?

column1: 第一面 戰前 天狼
column4: 不知道。夢裡有個聲音要我讀，沒說要讀多久。我總不能為了一個小孩收起星圖。
column5: No idea. A voice in a dream told me to read them. It didn't say for how long. I'm not rolling up the chart for a kid.

column1: 第一面 戰前 天狼
column4: 那我就打到你收為止！
column5: Then I'll fight you until you do!

column1: 第一面 戰前 天狼
column4: 這麼晚還上山。獵人？
column5: Climbing the mountain this late. A hunter?

column1: 第一面 戰前 天狼
column4: 沒有星星，夜裡認不了路。陷阱放了三天，一個都找不回來。
column5: No stars, no way to find the paths at night. I set traps three days ago and can't find a single one.

column1: 第一面 戰前 天狼
column4: 那真是抱歉了。星星在我這裡。
column5: My apologies, then. The stars are with me.

column1: 第一面 戰前 天狼
column4: 還來。
column5: Give them back.

column1: 第一面 戰前 天狼
column4: 天門之夜以前不行。有個聲音要我在那之前把星象讀完。
column5: Not before the Night of the Heaven's Gate. A voice told me to finish reading them by then.

column1: 第一面 戰前 天狼
column4: 我不管什麼聲音。今晚就還。
column5: I don't care about voices. Tonight.

column1: 第一面 戰前 天狼
column4: 不行。
column5: No.

column1: 第一面 戰前 天狼
column4: 那就打。
column5: Then we fight.

column1: 第一面 戰前 天狼
column4: 山伏？這條參道晚上不好走。
column5: A yamabushi? This path is no place to be at night.

column1: 第一面 戰前 天狼
column4: 我本來是看著北斗星走的～走到一半星星全不見了，現在連自己從哪裡來都不知道。
column5: I was following the Big Dipper~ Halfway up, every star vanished. Now I don't even know where I came from.

column1: 第一面 戰前 天狼
column4: 那是我借走的。
column5: I borrowed them.

column1: 第一面 戰前 天狼
column4: 星星可以借喔？那先借我北斗星就好，我想下山吃宵夜。
column5: You can borrow stars? Then just lend me the Big Dipper. I want to go down for a late-night snack.

column1: 第一面 戰前 天狼
column4: 一顆也不能少。少一顆，星象就讀不準。
column5: Not a single one. With one missing, the reading goes wrong.

column1: 第一面 戰前 天狼
column4: 可是我的晚飯在山下耶。
column5: But my dinner is down the mountain.

column1: 第一面 戰前 天狼
column4: 你真想要，就自己從星圖裡拿。拿得到再說。
column5: If you want it that badly, take it out of the chart yourself. Then we'll talk.

column1: 第一面 戰前 天狼
column4: 好喔，那我拿囉！
column5: Okay, I'm taking it!

column1: 第一面 戰前 天狼
column4: 帶著人偶上參道……這麼晚了，你不怕嗎？
column5: Climbing the shrine path with puppets... this late? Aren't you scared?

column1: 第一面 戰前 天狼
column4: 怕。可是孩子們說，星星的聲音是從這裡傳來的。
column5: I am. But the children say the stars' voices are coming from here.

column1: 第一面 戰前 天狼
column4: 星星的聲音？
column5: The stars' voices?

column1: 第一面 戰前 天狼
column4: 它們說，天上空了一大塊，星星全擠在這片石階上，很吵。
column5: They say there's a big hole in the sky, and all the stars are crammed onto these steps, being noisy.

column1: 第一面 戰前 天狼
column4: 你的人偶耳朵真好。沒錯，是我把星星請下來的。夢裡有人告訴我，天門之夜以前要讀完它們。
column5: Your puppets have good ears. Yes, I brought the stars down. Someone in a dream told me to read them all before the Night of the Heaven's Gate.

column1: 第一面 戰前 天狼
column4: 孩子們想把星星送回去。
column5: The children want to send the stars back.

column1: 第一面 戰前 天狼
column4: 我還沒讀完。想送回去，就先讓我看看它們有多少本事。
column5: I'm not done reading. If they want to send them back, let me see what they can do first.

column1: 第二面 戰前 千秋
column4: 站住，你腳下那一塊還沒乾。
column5: Stop. The paint under your feet isn't dry yet.

column1: 第二面 戰前 千秋
column4: 又是畫在地上的東西……這山谷怎麼同時在下雪又開櫻花？
column5: Another thing painted on the ground... Why is this valley snowing and blooming at the same time?

column1: 第二面 戰前 千秋
column4: 我在畫四季。春夏秋冬放進同一幅畫裡，畫完以前會有點亂。
column5: I'm painting the four seasons. Spring, summer, autumn and winter in one picture. It's a bit of a mess until I finish.

column1: 第二面 戰前 千秋
column4: 有點？山下的稻子凍死了一半！
column5: A bit? Half the rice down the mountain froze to death!

column1: 第二面 戰前 千秋
column4: ……那我很抱歉。可是有人在夢裡跟我說，四季就要散了，要我趁現在把它們畫下來。
column5: ...I'm sorry about that. But someone told me in a dream that the seasons are about to scatter, and to paint them while I still can.

column1: 第二面 戰前 千秋
column4: 夢裡？參道上那個看星星的，也說他聽到聲音！
column5: In a dream? The stargazer on the shrine path said he heard a voice too!

column1: 第二面 戰前 千秋
column4: 他也是？那我更不能停了。不只我一個人聽見，就表示那是真的。
column5: Him too? Then I really can't stop. If I'm not the only one who heard it, it's real.

column1: 第二面 戰前 千秋
column4: 真的假的我不管，先把季節放回去！
column5: Real or not, put the seasons back first!

column1: 第二面 戰前 千秋
column4: 你的弓，可以讓我畫一張嗎？一下就好。
column5: Your bow. May I paint it? Just for a moment.

column1: 第二面 戰前 千秋
column4: 不行。山谷的雪是你下的？
column5: No. Is the snow in this valley your doing?

column1: 第二面 戰前 千秋
column4: 雪、櫻花、楓葉、蟬聲，都是我畫的。四季就要散了，我得把它們留在紙上。
column5: The snow, the blossoms, the maple leaves, the cicadas. All mine. The seasons are about to scatter, so I'm keeping them on paper.

column1: 第二面 戰前 千秋
column4: 誰說的。
column5: Who says so?

column1: 第二面 戰前 千秋
column4: 夢裡的聲音。
column5: A voice in a dream.

column1: 第二面 戰前 千秋
column4: 上面那個看星星的，也這麼說。
column5: The stargazer up there said the same.

column1: 第二面 戰前 千秋
column4: 原來不只我……那我更要畫完。抱歉了，獵人，畫到一半的東西，我不給人碰。
column5: So it isn't just me... Then I have to finish. Sorry, hunter. Nobody touches a painting of mine halfway through.

column1: 第二面 戰前 千秋
column4: 那就別怪我把紙射穿。
column5: Then don't blame me when I shoot through the paper.

column1: 第二面 戰前 千秋
column4: 啊，別踩——算了，你踩的那塊，顏色反而好看。
column5: Ah, don't step on— never mind. The colour looks better where you stepped.

column1: 第二面 戰前 千秋
column4: 這裡好奇怪喔～我剛剛在雪地裡撿到一顆熟透的柿子。
column5: This place is so weird~ I just found a ripe persimmon in the snow.

column1: 第二面 戰前 千秋
column4: 那是秋天那一段的。你吃了？
column5: That's from the autumn part. Did you eat it?

column1: 第二面 戰前 千秋
column4: 吃了！冰冰的，很好吃。
column5: I did! Nice and cold. Delicious.

column1: 第二面 戰前 千秋
column4: 那顆我還沒畫完。
column5: I hadn't finished painting that one.

column1: 第二面 戰前 千秋
column4: 啊，對不起。所以這裡的季節，全是你畫出來的喔？
column5: Oh, sorry. So all the seasons here are things you painted?

column1: 第二面 戰前 千秋
column4: 夢裡有人拜託我，在四季散掉以前把它們畫下來。
column5: Someone in a dream asked me to paint the seasons before they scatter.

column1: 第二面 戰前 千秋
column4: 又是夢喔？星星那個人也是做夢耶。
column5: A dream again? The star guy had a dream too.

column1: 第二面 戰前 千秋
column4: 他在哪裡？
column5: Where is he?

column1: 第二面 戰前 千秋
column4: 被我打倒了，在參道上睡覺～
column5: I beat him. He's napping on the shrine path~

column1: 第二面 戰前 千秋
column4: 那我得小心了。畫完以前，誰都別想讓我放下筆。
column5: Then I'd better be careful. Until I finish, no one makes me put down my brush.

column1: 第二面 戰前 千秋
column4: 好安靜的客人。你身邊那幾個孩子，也是人偶吧？可以借我畫嗎？
column5: What a quiet guest. Those little ones with you are puppets too, aren't they? May I paint them?

column1: 第二面 戰前 千秋
column4: 它們不喜歡被盯著看。這個山谷冷熱一直在換，孩子們頭很暈。
column5: They don't like being stared at. This valley keeps turning hot and cold. It makes the children dizzy.

column1: 第二面 戰前 千秋
column4: 那是我在畫四季。抱歉，再一下就好。
column5: That's me painting the seasons. Sorry. Just a little longer.

column1: 第二面 戰前 千秋
column4: 參道上的人也說「再一下」。他說，有聲音要他讀星星。
column5: The man on the shrine path said 'a little longer' too. He said a voice told him to read the stars.

column1: 第二面 戰前 千秋
column4: 我也是聽了聲音。它說四季要散了……說話的樣子很累。
column5: I heard a voice too. It said the seasons would scatter... It sounded so tired.

column1: 第二面 戰前 千秋
column4: 孩子們說，那個聲音是從很高的地方來的。
column5: The children say that voice comes from somewhere very high up.

column1: 第二面 戰前 千秋
column4: 那我更得把畫畫完，好拿給它看。請別攔我。
column5: Then I have to finish all the more, so I can show it. Please don't stop me.

column1: 第二面 戰前 千秋
column4: 孩子們會小心，不弄髒你的畫。
column5: The children will be careful not to smudge your painting.

column1: 第三面 戰前 嵐
column4: 哪來的小鬼，敢踩上我的雲！
column5: Where did this brat come from, walking on my clouds!

column1: 第三面 戰前 嵐
column4: 山下連下了七天雨，河都快滿出來了，是你吧！
column5: It's rained for seven days down there. The river's about to flood. That's you, isn't it!

column1: 第三面 戰前 嵐
column4: 是我又怎樣？雲是我聚的，雨愛下哪就下哪。
column5: So what if it is? I gather the clouds, the rain falls where it likes.

column1: 第三面 戰前 嵐
column4: 你是不是也聽到什麼聲音？看星星的跟畫畫的，都說有人在夢裡叫他們做事。
column5: Do you hear a voice too? The stargazer and the painter both said someone in a dream told them what to do.

column1: 第三面 戰前 嵐
column4: 那兩個傢伙也是？哼，我才不是聽誰的話。我是自己想聚雲。
column5: Those two as well? Hmph. I don't take orders. I gather clouds because I want to.

column1: 第三面 戰前 嵐
column4: 那雲呢？你一聚好，就全往上面飄走了。
column5: Then where are the clouds going? The moment you gather them, they drift upward.

column1: 第三面 戰前 嵐
column4: 你也看到了？我聚一團，上面就吸走一團。不知道是哪個混帳在偷我的雲！
column5: You saw that too? Every cloud I gather gets sucked up. Some bastard up there is stealing my clouds!

column1: 第三面 戰前 嵐
column4: 那你停手不就好了？
column5: Then why not just stop?

column1: 第三面 戰前 嵐
column4: 停手就輸了！在搞清楚之前，誰都別想叫我停——你也一樣！
column5: Stopping means losing! Until I figure this out, nobody tells me to stop. That includes you!

column1: 第三面 戰前 嵐
column4: 又一個不怕被雷劈的。
column5: Another one who isn't afraid of lightning.

column1: 第三面 戰前 嵐
column4: 你的雷，劈壞了山下三間屋子。
column5: Your lightning broke three houses down the mountain.

column1: 第三面 戰前 嵐
column4: 要賠找天上那傢伙賠！雲是我聚的，可是一聚好就被吸上去，害我只能一直聚！
column5: Take it up with whoever's in the sky! I gather the clouds, but they get sucked up the moment I'm done, so I keep gathering more!

column1: 第三面 戰前 嵐
column4: 被吸上去？
column5: Sucked up?

column1: 第三面 戰前 嵐
column4: 你自己看。
column5: See for yourself.

column1: 第三面 戰前 嵐
column4: 看星星的跟畫畫的，也說夢裡有人叫他們做事。
column5: The stargazer and the painter said someone in a dream gave them orders too.

column1: 第三面 戰前 嵐
column4: 我沒那麼好使喚。不過那聲音確實很吵。
column5: I'm not that easy to order around. Though that voice is noisy, I'll give you that.

column1: 第三面 戰前 嵐
column4: 讓雨停。
column5: Stop the rain.

column1: 第三面 戰前 嵐
column4: 想讓我停，就拿出本事來！
column5: If you want me to stop, show me what you've got!

column1: 第三面 戰前 嵐
column4: 喂！那是雲，不是床！給我起來！
column5: Hey! That's a cloud, not a bed! Get up!

column1: 第三面 戰前 嵐
column4: 好軟喔……我爬了好久的山，休息一下嘛。
column5: It's so soft... I've been climbing forever. Let me rest a bit.

column1: 第三面 戰前 嵐
column4: 我是天氣之主嵐！在我的雲上睡午覺，你膽子不小！
column5: I am Arashi, lord of the weather! Napping on my clouds takes some nerve!

column1: 第三面 戰前 嵐
column4: 天氣之主？那為什麼一直下雨呀？我的衣服濕了三天了。
column5: Lord of the weather? Then why won't the rain stop? My clothes have been wet for three days.

column1: 第三面 戰前 嵐
column4: 我在聚雲！可是不管聚多少都被往上吸走，只好一直聚！
column5: I'm gathering clouds! But however many I gather, they get sucked upward, so I have to keep at it!

column1: 第三面 戰前 嵐
column4: 喔～所以你是雲被拿走在生氣。跟星星那個人、畫畫那個人一樣，大家都被什麼東西搞得團團轉耶。
column5: Oh~ so you're mad because someone took your clouds. Like the star guy and the painter. Everyone's being spun around by something.

column1: 第三面 戰前 嵐
column4: 誰團團轉了！我才沒有！
column5: Who's spinning around! Not me!

column1: 第三面 戰前 嵐
column4: 好好好，那你下完這場就休息一下嘛。
column5: Okay, okay. Then take a break after this rain.

column1: 第三面 戰前 嵐
column4: 少囉嗦！想要晴天，先撐過這場暴雨！
column5: Quiet! You want clear skies? Survive this storm first!

column1: 第三面 戰前 嵐
column4: 小鬼，抱著一堆娃娃跑上雲來幹什麼？
column5: Kid, what are you doing up on the clouds with an armful of dolls?

column1: 第三面 戰前 嵐
column4: 孩子們的衣服一直乾不了。雨下太久，它們都快發霉了。
column5: The children's clothes never dry. It's rained so long they're starting to mould.

column1: 第三面 戰前 嵐
column4: 發霉？那是你家的事。
column5: Mould? That's your problem.

column1: 第三面 戰前 嵐
column4: 孩子們說，你的雲一直被拉到更高的地方。
column5: The children say your clouds keep being pulled somewhere higher.

column1: 第三面 戰前 嵐
column4: 它們看得到？
column5: They can see that?

column1: 第三面 戰前 嵐
column4: 看得到。像有一根線，在上面拉著。
column5: They can. Like a string pulling from above.

column1: 第三面 戰前 嵐
column4: 線？哼，要是讓我知道是誰在拉，我非劈了他不可。
column5: A string? Hmph. If I ever find out who's pulling it, I'll strike him down.

column1: 第三面 戰前 嵐
column4: 參道的人和畫畫的人，也被同一根線拉著。
column5: The man on the shrine path and the painter are on the same string.

column1: 第三面 戰前 嵐
column4: 我才不是什麼人偶！既然你這麼會看，就看看我的雷吧！
column5: I'm nobody's puppet! If you're so good at seeing things, take a look at my lightning!

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 擅自闖入，有失禮數。閣下所為何來？
column5: Entering uninvited is ill-mannered. What brings you here?

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 山裡的樹全都往你這裡長，連路都被樹根擋住了。是你吧？
column5: Every tree on the mountain is growing toward this place. The roots have blocked the paths. That's you, right?

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 在下奉天命，替山守住草木之氣。
column5: I am keeping the mountain's plant spirit safe, by heaven's order.

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 天命？是不是夢裡的聲音？
column5: Heaven's order? A voice in a dream, by any chance?

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 閣下怎麼知道？
column5: How would you know that?

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 看星星的、畫畫的、叫雨的那個，全都聽到了。
column5: The stargazer, the painter and the rain guy all heard it.

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 三人皆然……星辰、四時、天候，再加上在下守的草木之氣，全都被引往天頂。看來不是天命，是有人在收東西。
column5: All three of them... The stars, the seasons, the weather, and the plant spirit I keep, all drawn toward the sky. That isn't heaven's order. Someone is collecting.

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 收去幹嘛？
column5: Collecting it for what?

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 在下不知。五行仙壇的玄精通天象，或許清楚。
column5: I do not know. Gen of the Altar of the Five Elements knows the heavens well. He may.

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 那你讓開，我去問他。
column5: Then let me through and I'll go ask him.

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 天命未解之前，在下仍得守住此地。要過去，請先勝過在下。
column5: Until this order is understood, I must still hold this place. If you wish to pass, you must first defeat me.

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 持弓入園，殺氣太重。
column5: You enter a garden carrying a bow. Far too much killing intent.

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 林子裡的獸道全被樹根封了。我要過去。
column5: Every animal trail in the woods is sealed off by roots. I'm going through.

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 那是在下聚的草木之氣。天命所託，不能讓。
column5: That is the plant spirit I have gathered. Heaven entrusted it to me. I cannot give way.

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 天命。夢裡的？
column5: Heaven. From a dream?

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 閣下也聽過？
column5: You have heard it too?

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 我沒有。是我一路打倒的人聽過。
column5: No. The people I beat on the way here did.

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 一路打倒……難怪閣下身上的氣這麼雜。星、季、雲，全纏在閣下身上。
column5: Beat on the way... No wonder your spirit is so mixed. Stars, seasons, clouds, all tangled around you.

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 我不在乎。讓路。
column5: I don't care. Move.

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 若天命要閣下來取，在下更該確認閣下取得起。請。
column5: If heaven means for you to take it, all the more reason I make sure you can carry it. Please.

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 這位修行者，入園之前，請先把鞋上的泥擦掉。
column5: Traveller, please wipe the mud off your shoes before entering the garden.

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 啊，抱歉抱歉～你家竹子長得好好喔，筍子可以挖嗎？
column5: Ah, sorry, sorry~ Your bamboo's growing so well. Can I dig up some shoots?

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 竹乃君子，豈可食之。
column5: Bamboo is a gentleman. One does not eat a gentleman.

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 可是很好吃耶。對了，山上的樹全朝這裡長，害我繞了好遠的路。你也是被夢叫來做這個的嗎？
column5: But they're tasty. Oh, right, every tree on the mountain grows this way, so I had to take a huge detour. Did a dream tell you to do this too?

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 閣下何以得知？
column5: How do you know that?

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 前面三個人都是這樣啊。星星、季節、雲，現在是樹。好像有人在湊東西。
column5: The three people before you were all like that. Stars, seasons, clouds, and now trees. It's like someone is collecting a set.

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 湊……確實。在下的草木之氣，也日夜往天頂流去。
column5: Collecting... Indeed. My plant spirit has been flowing toward the sky day and night.

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 往天上？上面是不是有人在等著吃？
column5: Toward the sky? Is someone up there waiting to eat it?

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 閣下說得粗俗，倒也未必錯。要知道上面是誰，可去五行仙壇問玄。只是，在下的職責還沒卸下。
column5: Crudely put, but perhaps not wrong. To learn who it is, ask Gen at the Altar of the Five Elements. But my duty here is not yet done.

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 那我先陪你練一下囉！
column5: Then I'll spar with you first!

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 客人有禮。是來賞花的嗎？
column5: A polite guest. Have you come to view the flowers?

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 花很漂亮。可是孩子們說，山裡的草木都很累。
column5: They're beautiful. But the children say the plants on the mountain are very tired.

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 人偶也懂得草木的累嗎？
column5: Puppets can tell when plants are tired?

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 它們的身體是木頭做的。
column5: Their bodies are made of wood.

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 原來如此。在下奉天命，聚集山中靈氣，守到天門之夜。
column5: I see. By heaven's order, I am gathering the mountain's spirit and keeping it until the Night of the Heaven's Gate.

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 星星、季節、雲，也都被人收著。孩子們說，最後全往同一個地方去。
column5: The stars, the seasons and the clouds are being kept too. The children say they all end up going to the same place.

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 天頂。在下也感覺到了。五行仙壇的玄比誰都清楚天上的事，閣下可以去問他。
column5: The top of the sky. I have felt it as well. Gen of the Altar of the Five Elements knows the heavens better than anyone. You may ask him.

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 那，可以讓我們過去嗎？
column5: Then may we pass?

column1: 第四面 戰前 墨竹
column4: 天命還在在下肩上。要過去，得先讓在下看見，閣下擔得起。
column5: Heaven's order still rests on my shoulders. To pass, you must first show me you can bear it.

column1: 第四面 戰後 墨竹
column4: 梅、蘭、竹、菊，竟一一敗在閣下手上。
column5: Plum, orchid, bamboo, chrysanthemum... each one beaten by you.

column1: 第四面 戰後 墨竹
column4: 奇怪。在下的靈氣沒有回到山裡，反而流到閣下身上了。
column5: Strange. My spirit did not return to the mountain. It flowed into you instead.

column1: 第四面 戰後 墨竹
column4: 我身上？難怪從剛才開始一直在發燙。
column5: Into me? So that's why I've felt hot since a moment ago.

column1: 第四面 戰後 墨竹
column4: 閣下一路打倒的人，他們的力量恐怕都在閣下這裡。往五行仙壇去吧，玄會告訴你為什麼。
column5: The power of everyone you defeated on your way is probably with you now. Go to the Altar of the Five Elements. Gen will tell you why.

column1: 第四面 戰後 墨竹
column4: 好。謝了，書生。
column5: Got it. Thanks, scholar.

column1: 第四面 戰後 墨竹
column4: 墨竹。在下名叫墨竹。
column5: Mochiku. My name is Mochiku.

column1: 第四面 戰後 墨竹
column4: 好箭。在下輸了。
column5: Fine archery. I have lost.

column1: 第四面 戰後 墨竹
column4: 你的氣，往我這邊來了。
column5: Your spirit is coming my way.

column1: 第四面 戰後 墨竹
column4: 閣下也感覺到了？星、季、雲，加上在下的草木。閣下一路收集的，恐怕不是巧合。
column5: You feel it too? Stars, seasons, clouds, and now my plants. What you have been gathering is no coincidence.

column1: 第四面 戰後 墨竹
column4: 玄在哪。
column5: Where's Gen?

column1: 第四面 戰後 墨竹
column4: 往上，五行仙壇。他說話喜歡繞圈子，請耐著性子。
column5: Up the mountain, at the Altar of the Five Elements. He likes to talk in circles. Be patient with him.

column1: 第四面 戰後 墨竹
column4: 我盡量。
column5: I'll try.

column1: 第四面 戰後 墨竹
column4: 在下的庭園，被閣下踩得一塌糊塗。
column5: You have trampled my garden into a ruin.

column1: 第四面 戰後 墨竹
column4: 對不起嘛～咦，我怎麼又餓了，剛剛才吃過饅頭。
column5: Sorry~ Huh, why am I hungry again? I just ate a bun.

column1: 第四面 戰後 墨竹
column4: 那不是餓。在下的草木之氣流進了閣下體內，還有星辰、四時、天候。
column5: That is not hunger. My plant spirit has flowed into you, along with the stars, the seasons and the weather.

column1: 第四面 戰後 墨竹
column4: 我吃了那麼多東西喔？
column5: I ate all that?

column1: 第四面 戰後 墨竹
column4: 算是吧。五行仙壇的玄知道這是怎麼回事，去問他。
column5: In a sense. Gen of the Altar of the Five Elements knows what this means. Go and ask him.

column1: 第四面 戰後 墨竹
column4: 好！順便問他有沒有吃的。
column5: Okay! I'll ask if he has any food while I'm at it.

column1: 第四面 戰後 墨竹
column4: 人偶師，在下的四君子都向你低頭了。
column5: Puppeteer, all four of my gentlemen bow to you.

column1: 第四面 戰後 墨竹
column4: 孩子們說，你的花其實很溫柔。
column5: The children say your flowers are actually gentle.

column1: 第四面 戰後 墨竹
column4: 多謝。那聲音說，要守到有人來取。在下一直以為，取的是天。
column5: Thank you. The voice told me to keep it until someone came to take it. I always assumed that someone was heaven.

column1: 第四面 戰後 墨竹
column4: 不是嗎？
column5: It isn't?

column1: 第四面 戰後 墨竹
column4: 靈氣現在在閣下身上。也許，等的就是你。去五行仙壇問玄吧。
column5: The spirit is with you now. Perhaps it was you it was waiting for. Go ask Gen at the Altar of the Five Elements.

column1: 第四面 戰後 墨竹
column4: 孩子們，我們走。
column5: Children, let's go.

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 你來了。比卦象晚了一刻。
column5: You've come. A quarter-hour later than the divination said.

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 你早就知道我會來？那你一定也知道，夢裡那個聲音是誰！
column5: You knew I'd come? Then you must know whose voice is in the dreams!

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 天宮的守護者，燁。
column5: Yoh, guardian of the Heavenly Palace.

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 燁……他為什麼要大家去偷星星、搶季節？
column5: Yoh... Why make everyone steal stars and snatch seasons?

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 四神結界快碎了，他也快撐不住了。補結界需要力量，而那份力量只認勝者。
column5: The Barrier of the Four Gods is about to break, and he can barely hold on. Mending it takes power, and that power only answers to a victor.

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 勝者？
column5: A victor?

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 打倒守門人的人。我們五個各守一份，等人來一一贏過。你身上已經有四份了。
column5: Someone who defeats the gatekeepers. The five of us each hold one share, waiting for someone to beat us one by one. You already carry four.

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 所以我一路打過來，全照著他的意思？
column5: So everything I did on the way here went exactly the way he wanted?

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 是。
column5: Yes.

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 那你們呢？明知道被安排了，還照做？
column5: And you? You knew you were being used, and you went along with it?

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 我知道，其他人不知道。
column5: I knew. The others didn't.

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 這種事應該好好說清楚！
column5: Something like this should be said plainly!

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 說清楚了，你就會來嗎？第五份在我這裡。想上天宮問他，就拿走它。
column5: Would you have come if it had been? The fifth share is with me. If you want to go up and ask him, take it.

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 你的箭，屬金。
column5: Your arrows belong to Metal.

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 我不聽卦。夢裡的聲音是誰。
column5: I'm not here for fortunes. Whose voice is in the dreams?

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 天宮的燁。守著四神結界的人。
column5: Yoh of the Heavenly Palace. The one who guards the Barrier of the Four Gods.

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 他要什麼。
column5: What does he want?

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 要一個人，一路贏過五個守門人，把五份力量帶上天宮。結界只認勝者的力量。
column5: Someone who beats five gatekeepers in a row and carries their five shares up to the palace. The barrier only accepts a victor's power.

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 我只是來收陷阱的。
column5: I only came to collect my traps.

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 卦象不管你為什麼來。你已經走到這裡，身上背著四份。
column5: The divination doesn't care why you came. You're here, carrying four shares.

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 所以我是被拿來搬東西的。
column5: So I'm being used to haul things.

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 你可以在這裡轉身。
column5: You can turn back here.

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 轉身，雨會停嗎？星星會回來嗎？
column5: If I turn back, does the rain stop? Do the stars come back?

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 不會。
column5: No.

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 那就打。
column5: Then we fight.

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 山伏也懂五行？
column5: A yamabushi who knows the five elements?

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 一點點～木頭生火烤地瓜，火燒水泡茶！
column5: A little~ Wood makes fire for roasting sweet potatoes, fire boils water for tea!

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 倒也沒錯。那你知道，你身上已經背了四份力量嗎？
column5: Not wrong. Then do you know you're already carrying four shares of power?

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 難怪一直很餓！這也是你們搞的喔？
column5: No wonder I'm always hungry! Is this your doing too?

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 是天宮的燁安排的。四神結界快碎了，他要找一個人一路贏過我們，把力量帶上去補結界。
column5: Yoh of the Heavenly Palace arranged it. The Barrier of the Four Gods is about to break. He needs someone to beat all of us and carry the power up to mend it.

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 他為什麼不自己來拿？
column5: Why doesn't he come and get it himself?

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 他離不開天宮，也已經沒力氣贏過任何人了。
column5: He can't leave the palace, and he no longer has the strength to beat anyone.

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 好麻煩喔……那他有沒有好好吃飯啊？撐那麼久，一定很累。
column5: What a hassle... Is he eating properly? Holding on that long must be exhausting.

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 這倒沒人想過。先把第五份拿走吧，上去以後你自己問他。
column5: No one ever thought to ask that. Take the fifth share first. You can ask him yourself up there.

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 好，那我收下囉！
column5: Okay, I'll take it then!

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 人偶師。你的人偶，屬木，還是屬土？
column5: Puppeteer. Do your puppets belong to Wood, or to Earth?

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 它們屬於我。請告訴我們，那根線的另一頭是誰。
column5: They belong to me. Please tell us who's at the other end of the string.

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 線？說得好。天宮的守護者，燁。他用夢牽著我們五個，又讓你一路收走我們的力量。
column5: A string? Well put. Yoh, the guardian of the Heavenly Palace. He holds the five of us with dreams, and has you gather up our power one by one.

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 為什麼要這樣做？
column5: Why would he do that?

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 四神結界快碎了。補它的力量只認勝者，而他已經沒力氣自己去贏。
column5: The Barrier of the Four Gods is about to break. The power to mend it only answers to a victor, and he no longer has the strength to win on his own.

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 孩子們說，那個聲音一直很寂寞。
column5: The children say that voice has always been lonely.

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 人偶看得比人清楚。最後一份在我這裡。你們想替他分擔，就拿去。
column5: Puppets see more clearly than people. The last share is with me. If you want to help carry his load, take it.

column1: 第五面 戰前 玄
column4: 孩子們，準備好了嗎？
column5: Children, are you ready?

column1: 第五面 戰後 玄
column4: 五行已盡。卦象沒錯，你裝得下。
column5: The five elements are spent. The divination was right. You can hold it.

column1: 第五面 戰後 玄
column4: 身體好燙……這就是五份力量？
column5: I'm burning up... Is this the five shares?

column1: 第五面 戰後 玄
column4: 是。往上走，雲會讓路。燁就在天宮等。
column5: It is. Go up. The clouds will part for you. Yoh is waiting in the palace.

column1: 第五面 戰後 玄
column4: 你們被他這樣用，不生氣嗎？
column5: Doesn't it make you angry, being used like that?

column1: 第五面 戰後 玄
column4: 我們都夢到了同一個快要崩掉的世界。能撐住它，當一次棋子也沒什麼。
column5: We all dreamed of the same world about to collapse. If it holds, being a game piece once is nothing.

column1: 第五面 戰後 玄
column4: 我會氣。我會替你們問他。
column5: It makes me angry. I'll ask him for all of you.

column1: 第五面 戰後 玄
column4: 去吧。天門之夜就快到了。
column5: Go. The Night of the Heaven's Gate is almost here.

column1: 第五面 戰後 玄
column4: 金克木，箭穿五行。卦象沒騙我。
column5: Metal cuts Wood; an arrow pierced the five elements. The divination didn't lie.

column1: 第五面 戰後 玄
column4: 天宮怎麼走。
column5: How do I get to the palace?

column1: 第五面 戰後 玄
column4: 往上。雲會讓路。
column5: Up. The clouds will part.

column1: 第五面 戰後 玄
column4: 你們甘心被他用？
column5: You're fine with being used by him?

column1: 第五面 戰後 玄
column4: 棋盤要是毀了，就沒有棋子可言。我們只是選了守住棋盤的那一步。
column5: If the board is destroyed, there are no pieces left. We just chose the move that keeps the board.

column1: 第五面 戰後 玄
column4: 我不喜歡被人下。但這一步，我自己走。
column5: I don't like being played. But this move, I'll make myself.

column1: 第五面 戰後 玄
column4: 五行皆盡。你現在，比剛才更餓了吧？
column5: The five elements are spent. You're even hungrier than before, aren't you?

column1: 第五面 戰後 玄
column4: 你怎麼知道！肚子一直叫！
column5: How did you know! My stomach won't stop growling!

column1: 第五面 戰後 玄
column4: 那是五份力量在你體內打轉。上天宮吧。
column5: That's five shares of power swirling inside you. Go up to the palace.

column1: 第五面 戰後 玄
column4: 燁會請我吃飯嗎？
column5: Will Yoh feed me?

column1: 第五面 戰後 玄
column4: 卦象沒說。
column5: The divination didn't say.

column1: 第五面 戰後 玄
column4: 那我自己跟他講！
column5: Then I'll ask him myself!

column1: 第五面 戰後 玄
column4: 五行相生，最後都流到了你身上。
column5: The five elements gave rise to one another, and in the end they all flowed into you.

column1: 第五面 戰後 玄
column4: 孩子們說，好重。
column5: The children say it's heavy.

column1: 第五面 戰後 玄
column4: 那是結界的重量。燁一個人扛了好幾百年。
column5: That's the weight of the barrier. Yoh has carried it alone for centuries.

column1: 第五面 戰後 玄
column4: 一個人扛……孩子們說，那一定很冷。
column5: Carrying it alone... The children say that must be cold.

column1: 第五面 戰後 玄
column4: 上天宮吧。你和你的孩子們，也許能替他分一些。
column5: Go up to the palace. You and your children might take some of it off him.

column1: 第五面 戰後 玄
column4: 我們一起去。
column5: We'll go together.

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 你來了。走到這裡的人，你是第一個。
column5: You've come. You're the first to make it this far.

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 你就是燁吧？看星星的、畫畫的、叫雨的、墨竹，還有玄——大家會鬧事，全是你安排的！
column5: You're Yoh, right? The stargazer, the painter, the rain guy, Mochiku and Gen. Everything they did, you set it up!

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 是。四神結界撐不過今晚的天門之夜，而我已經沒有力氣補它。
column5: Yes. The Barrier of the Four Gods won't last through tonight's Night of the Heaven's Gate, and I no longer have the strength to mend it.

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 那為什麼不直接說？找人來幫忙不就好了！
column5: Then why not just say so? Why not ask for help!

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 結界的力量只跟隨勝者。我離不開天宮，只好讓五個人各守一份，等有人一一勝過他們。
column5: The barrier's power only follows a victor. I can't leave the palace, so I had five people each hold a share and waited for someone to beat them.

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 你知道山下變成什麼樣子嗎？星星沒了，稻子凍死，河都快淹出來了！
column5: Do you know what it's like down there? No stars, frozen rice, a river about to flood!

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 知道。每一件我都看著。
column5: I know. I watched every bit of it.

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 看著，卻什麼都不做？
column5: You watched and did nothing?

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 我做了。我讓你來到這裡。
column5: I did something. I brought you here.

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 這不是同一件事！
column5: That's not the same thing!

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 我知道。所以最後，我要用四神之力親自試你。你若撐不住，這些力量也撐不住結界。
column5: I know. So, at the end, I'll test you myself with the power of the Four Gods. If you can't hold up, neither can the barrier.

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 好！打完以後，你給我下山，跟每個人道歉！
column5: Fine! When this is over, you're coming down the mountain to apologise to every one of them!

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 獵人。你一路射穿了五道門。
column5: Hunter. You've shot your way through five gates.

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 我只是想收陷阱。
column5: I only wanted my traps back.

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 我知道。對你而言，這全是多出來的事。
column5: I know. For you, all of this was beside the point.

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 為了補結界，讓五個人去鬧，讓我去打。
column5: To mend the barrier, you set five people loose and sent me to fight them.

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 結界只認勝者的力量。我離不開這裡，沒有別的辦法。
column5: The barrier only accepts a victor's power. I can't leave this place. There was no other way.

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 有。你可以說。
column5: There was. You could have said so.

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 說了，誰會信？一個夢裡的聲音說天要塌了。
column5: And who would believe it? A voice in a dream saying the sky is falling.

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 下了七天雨，誰都會信。
column5: After seven days of rain, anyone would.

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 也許你說得對。是我太習慣一個人做決定了。
column5: Perhaps you're right. I've grown too used to deciding everything alone.

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 那就快點結束。
column5: Then let's finish this.

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 好。四神為證，讓我看看你的箭能不能抵達天頂。
column5: Very well. With the Four Gods as witness, show me whether your arrows can reach the top of the sky.

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 修行者，歡迎來到天宮。
column5: Welcome to the Heavenly Palace, traveller.

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 哇——好漂亮！……不對不對，我是來念你的！
column5: Wow, it's so pretty! ...No, wait, I'm here to scold you!

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 念我？
column5: Scold me?

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 你讓大家做奇怪的夢，害星星不見、雨下不停，山下的人都沒辦法好好吃飯！
column5: You gave everyone weird dreams, the stars vanished, the rain won't stop, and nobody down there can eat properly!

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 是我。四神結界今晚就會碎，我已經補不動了。結界的力量只跟隨勝者，所以我讓五個人各守一份，等人來拿。
column5: That was me. The Barrier of the Four Gods breaks tonight, and I can't mend it anymore. Its power only follows a victor, so I had five people each keep a share until someone came to take them.

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 所以我一路餓肚子，都是在幫你搬東西？
column5: So I've been starving the whole way just to carry your stuff?

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 可以這麼說。
column5: You could put it that way.

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 那你自己呢？你多久沒吃飯了？
column5: And you? When did you last eat?

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 守護者不需要吃飯。
column5: A guardian doesn't need to eat.

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 騙人，看你的臉色就知道。
column5: Liar. One look at your face says otherwise.

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 先把試煉做完吧。你背上的五份力量，我得確定你承受得住。
column5: Let's finish the trial first. I need to be sure you can bear the five shares you carry.

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 好喔，那打完你要吃飯！
column5: Okay, but after this, you're eating!

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 安靜的孩子。你的人偶陪你走過了每一關。
column5: A quiet child. Your puppets have walked every step with you.

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 是孩子們帶我走過來的。它們說，您的線一直牽到這裡。
column5: It was the children who brought me. They say your string leads all the way here.

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 線……是啊。我用夢牽著五個人，也牽著你。
column5: A string... Yes. I held five people with dreams, and you as well.

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 為什麼不放開呢？
column5: Why not let go?

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 四神結界快碎了。補它的力量只跟隨勝者，我已經沒力氣自己去贏，只好讓守門人各執一份，等一個人來。
column5: The Barrier of the Four Gods is about to break. The power to mend it only follows a victor, and I can no longer win on my own. So I had the gatekeepers each hold a share and waited for someone to come.

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 大家都不是壞人，卻被當成壞人打倒了。
column5: None of them were bad people, but they were beaten like villains.

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 是我讓他們背了這個名。等結界補好，我會親自去向他們賠罪。
column5: I'm the one who put that name on them. Once the barrier is mended, I'll go and make amends to each of them myself.

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 孩子們說，您也該有人陪。
column5: The children say you should have someone with you too.

column1: 第六面 戰前 燁
column4: 那就讓我最後一次，用四神之力試你們。
column5: Then let me test you one last time, with the power of the Four Gods.

column1: 第六面 戰後 燁
column4: 勝負已分。四神之力，現在都在你身上了。
column5: It's decided. The power of the Four Gods is all yours now.

column1: 第六面 戰後 燁
column4: 那結界呢？補得起來嗎？
column5: And the barrier? Can it be mended?

column1: 第六面 戰後 燁
column4: 已經在補了。天門會在今晚安靜地開，再安靜地關上。
column5: It's already mending. The gate will open quietly tonight and close just as quietly.

column1: 第六面 戰後 燁
column4: 那你呢？力量都給我了，你會不見嗎？
column5: What about you? You gave me all your power. Will you disappear?

column1: 第六面 戰後 燁
column4: 不會，只是要睡一陣子。還有一件事——結界最舊的那道裂痕，不是今晚才有的。
column5: No. I'll just sleep for a while. One more thing: the oldest crack in the barrier wasn't made tonight.

column1: 第六面 戰後 燁
column4: 什麼意思？
column5: What do you mean?

column1: 第六面 戰後 燁
column4: 那是我五百年前犯的錯。改天再說吧。
column5: It's a mistake I made five hundred years ago. Another time.

column1: 第六面 戰後 燁
column4: 下次有事，直接說！別再讓大家打架了！
column5: Next time, just tell us! Don't make everyone fight again!

column1: 第六面 戰後 燁
column4: 我答應你。
column5: I promise.

column1: 第六面 戰後 燁
column4: 好箭。結界穩住了。
column5: Fine shooting. The barrier is holding.

column1: 第六面 戰後 燁
column4: 你利用了五個人。
column5: You used five people.

column1: 第六面 戰後 燁
column4: 我會記著。
column5: I'll remember that.

column1: 第六面 戰後 燁
column4: 不用記。玄說，他們是自己選的。
column5: No need. Gen said they chose it themselves.

column1: 第六面 戰後 燁
column4: 你比看起來溫柔。
column5: You're kinder than you look.

column1: 第六面 戰後 燁
column4: 少囉嗦。陷阱還在山下，我要走了。
column5: Spare me. My traps are still down there. I'm leaving.

column1: 第六面 戰後 燁
column4: 結界最舊的那道裂，我還補不了。若你哪天又路過天宮——
column5: There's an old crack in the barrier I still can't mend. If you ever pass by the palace again—

column1: 第六面 戰後 燁
column4: 看情況。
column5: We'll see.

column1: 第六面 戰後 燁
column4: 結束了。天門之夜會平安過去。
column5: It's over. The Night of the Heaven's Gate will pass safely.

column1: 第六面 戰後 燁
column4: 太好了！那可以吃飯了嗎？
column5: Great! So can we eat now?

column1: 第六面 戰後 燁
column4: 你一路打上來，就為了這個？
column5: You fought all the way up here for that?

column1: 第六面 戰後 燁
column4: 還有大家！他們都是因為你才那麼累的，你要好好跟他們說謝謝。
column5: And for everyone! They got worn out because of you. You have to thank them properly.

column1: 第六面 戰後 燁
column4: 是啊。我欠他們一句話。
column5: Yes. I owe them that.

column1: 第六面 戰後 燁
column4: 那就一起吃飯的時候說！
column5: Then say it over dinner, all together!

column1: 第六面 戰後 燁
column4: 好。等我醒來。
column5: All right. Once I wake up.

column1: 第六面 戰後 燁
column4: 人偶師，謝謝你。結界穩住了。
column5: Thank you, puppeteer. The barrier is holding.

column1: 第六面 戰後 燁
column4: 孩子們說，您的聲音不那麼寂寞了。
column5: The children say your voice doesn't sound so lonely anymore.

column1: 第六面 戰後 燁
column4: 五百年來，我一直以為只能靠自己。
column5: For five hundred years, I thought I could only rely on myself.

column1: 第六面 戰後 燁
column4: 那以後，讓孩子們也來看您。
column5: Then from now on, let the children visit you too.

column1: 第六面 戰後 燁
column4: 好。人偶師，你的孩子們有沒有注意到，更遠的地方還有一點光？
column5: I'd like that. Puppeteer, have your children noticed a faint light further off?

column1: 第六面 戰後 燁
column4: 有。它們一直在看。
column5: They have. They keep looking at it.

column1: 第六面 戰後 燁
column4: 那是我還沒還清的債。等我醒來，再告訴你。
column5: That's a debt I haven't repaid. I'll tell you about it when I wake.

column1: Extra 道中 玄
column4: 結界補好了，你卻還往上走。
column5: The barrier is mended, and yet you keep climbing.

column1: Extra 道中 玄
column4: 燁說，最舊的那道裂痕是他五百年前犯的錯。我想知道是什麼錯。
column5: Yoh said the oldest crack was a mistake he made five hundred years ago. I want to know what it was.

column1: Extra 道中 玄
column4: 他連這個都跟你說了。前面是天和閣，主人叫一索。五百年前，燁跟他賭了一局，十三枚天印就留在了那裡。最早的裂痕，就是從那時開始的。
column5: He even told you that. Ahead is the Tenhou Pavilion. Its master is called Isso. Five hundred years ago Yoh played a game with him, and the thirteen Heaven Seals stayed there. That's when the first crack appeared.

column1: Extra 道中 玄
column4: 那我去把天印拿回來！
column5: Then I'll go get the seals back!

column1: Extra 道中 玄
column4: 一索不會白白交出來。他只認牌桌上的輸贏，而他從來沒輸過。
column5: Isso won't just hand them over. He only trusts what's decided at the table, and he has never lost.

column1: Extra 道中 玄
column4: 那贏就好啦！
column5: Then I'll just win!

column1: Extra 道中 玄
column4: 說得容易。你連我這三卦都過不了，就別去讓他看笑話。
column5: Easy to say. If you can't get past my three divinations, don't go and make a fool of yourself in front of him.

column1: Extra 道中 玄
column4: 你的箭，還想往哪裡射？
column5: Where else do you mean to shoot?

column1: Extra 道中 玄
column4: 燁說還有一道裂沒補。我順路。
column5: Yoh said there's a crack left. It's on my way.

column1: Extra 道中 玄
column4: 順路……前面是天和閣。一索手上有十三枚天印，是五百年前從燁那裡贏來的，結界缺的就是它們。
column5: On your way... Ahead is the Tenhou Pavilion. Isso holds thirteen Heaven Seals he won from Yoh five hundred years ago. They're what the barrier is missing.

column1: Extra 道中 玄
column4: 那就拿回來。
column5: Then I'll take them back.

column1: Extra 道中 玄
column4: 他不收箭，只收牌。要拿回天印，得在他的牌桌上贏他。
column5: He doesn't take arrows, only tiles. To get the seals back, you have to beat him at his table.

column1: Extra 道中 玄
column4: 我不輸。
column5: I won't lose.

column1: Extra 道中 玄
column4: 每個坐上他牌桌的人都這麼說。讓我用三卦，看看你的運。
column5: Everyone who sits at his table says that. Let me read your luck with three divinations.

column1: Extra 道中 玄
column4: 山伏，你又來做什麼？
column5: Yamabushi, what are you doing here again?

column1: Extra 道中 玄
column4: 燁睡著了，沒人請我吃飯～我聞到前面有很香的味道，就一路走過來了！
column5: Yoh fell asleep and nobody's feeding me~ I smelled something delicious up ahead, so I followed it!

column1: Extra 道中 玄
column4: 那是天和閣的廚房。主人一索是個愛賭的雀聖，五百年前，燁的十三枚天印輸給了他。
column5: That's the kitchen of the Tenhou Pavilion. Its master, Isso, is a mahjong saint who loves a gamble. Five hundred years ago Yoh's thirteen Heaven Seals went to him.

column1: Extra 道中 玄
column4: 天印是什麼？好吃嗎？
column5: What's a Heaven Seal? Is it tasty?

column1: Extra 道中 玄
column4: 不能吃。是補結界最早那道裂痕要用的東西。你一進去，一索就會要你上牌桌，不贏他，他是不會交出來的。
column5: You can't eat it. It's what the barrier's oldest crack needs. The moment you walk in, Isso will have you at his table, and he won't hand them over unless you win.

column1: Extra 道中 玄
column4: 那我不要賭，我只要吃飯！
column5: Then I won't gamble. I just want to eat!

column1: Extra 道中 玄
column4: 他不會只請你吃飯。先讓我看看，你有沒有本事坐上那張桌子。
column5: He won't just feed you. First, let me see if you're good enough to sit at that table.

column1: Extra 道中 玄
column4: 人偶師，結界已經補好，你為何還往前走？
column5: Puppeteer, the barrier is mended. Why do you keep going?

column1: Extra 道中 玄
column4: 燁先生說的那點光，孩子們找到了。在前面。
column5: The children found the faint light Yoh spoke of. It's up ahead.

column1: Extra 道中 玄
column4: 天和閣。那光是十三枚天印。五百年前燁跟主人一索對賭，天印就留在那裡了。
column5: The Tenhou Pavilion. That light is thirteen Heaven Seals. Five hundred years ago Yoh gambled against its master, Isso, and the seals stayed there.

column1: Extra 道中 玄
column4: 孩子們想把它們帶回去，讓燁先生不用再背這個債。
column5: The children want to bring them back, so Yoh won't have to carry that debt anymore.

column1: Extra 道中 玄
column4: 一索只用牌局說話。贏不了他，天印一枚也帶不走。
column5: Isso only speaks through games. If you can't beat him, you won't take a single seal.

column1: Extra 道中 玄
column4: 我會怕。可是孩子們想去。
column5: I'm scared. But the children want to go.

column1: Extra 道中 玄
column4: 那就先過我這三卦吧。
column5: Then get through my three divinations first.

column1: Extra 戰前 一索
column4: 喲，玄放你上來了。坐吧，桌子都擺好了。
column5: Well, Gen let you through. Have a seat, the table's all set.

column1: Extra 戰前 一索
column4: 我不是來打牌的！十三枚天印，請你還給燁！
column5: I'm not here to play! Please give the thirteen Heaven Seals back to Yoh!

column1: Extra 戰前 一索
column4: 還，當然要還。我替他保管了五百年，就等這一天。
column5: Of course they go back. I've kept them for him for five hundred years, waiting for this day.

column1: Extra 戰前 一索
column4: 保管？玄說是你贏走的。
column5: Kept them? Gen said you won them.

column1: Extra 戰前 一索
column4: 是贏來的。那天燁想拿天印換一份永遠不輸的運氣，好一個人守著結界到永遠。我不能讓他換。
column5: I did win them. That day Yoh wanted to trade the seals for luck that never loses, so he could guard the barrier alone forever. I couldn't let him make that trade.

column1: Extra 戰前 一索
column4: 為什麼？
column5: Why not?

column1: Extra 戰前 一索
column4: 一個人不可能永遠不輸，他會把自己撐壞的。所以我贏下天印，替他收著，等他願意找人幫忙。你看，他不就找了你？
column5: No one alone can never lose. He'd have broken himself. So I won the seals and kept them for him until he was willing to ask for help. And look, he found you.

column1: Extra 戰前 一索
column4: 那現在就還給我吧！
column5: Then give them to me now!

column1: Extra 戰前 一索
column4: 天印很重，拿不穩的人會被壓垮。陪我打一局吧。你贏了，十三枚全帶走；輸了也沒關係，吃頓飯，下次再來。
column5: The seals are heavy. Anyone who can't hold them steady gets crushed. Play one game with me. Win, and all thirteen go with you. Lose, and that's fine too: have dinner and come back another time.

column1: Extra 戰前 一索
column4: 臉這麼冷，很適合打牌。
column5: A face that cold. Made for cards.

column1: Extra 戰前 一索
column4: 我不賭。天印。
column5: I don't gamble. The seals.

column1: Extra 戰前 一索
column4: 天印會還。可是得先確定，你拿得動。
column5: The seals will go back. But first I need to know you can carry them.

column1: Extra 戰前 一索
column4: 玄說你從沒輸過。
column5: Gen says you've never lost.

column1: Extra 戰前 一索
column4: 沒錯。燁那天也是不肯認輸，想一個人扛下所有事。
column5: That's right. Yoh wouldn't admit defeat that day either. He wanted to carry everything alone.

column1: Extra 戰前 一索
column4: 你留著天印，是在等他找人幫忙。
column5: You kept the seals, waiting for him to find help.

column1: Extra 戰前 一索
column4: 你這人眼睛真利。規矩很簡單：贏我，天印你帶回去。
column5: Sharp eyes. The rule is simple: beat me, and you take the seals home.

column1: Extra 戰前 一索
column4: 射箭也是賭。我沒射偏過。
column5: Every shot is a gamble. I've never missed.

column1: Extra 戰前 一索
column4: 哈哈！那就看你能不能聽牌到最後！
column5: Hahaha! Then let's see if you can stay one tile from winning to the very end!

column1: Extra 戰前 一索
column4: 山伏也來雀莊？先說好，輸了要洗碗喔。
column5: A yamabushi in a mahjong parlour? Fair warning: the loser does the dishes.

column1: Extra 戰前 一索
column4: 我是聞到味道來的！還有，玄說燁的天印在你這裡。
column5: I followed the smell! Also, Gen says Yoh's seals are here.

column1: Extra 戰前 一索
column4: 在，一枚也沒少。五百年前，他想用天印換我的不敗之運。
column5: They are, every one of them. Five hundred years ago he wanted to trade them for my unbeatable luck.

column1: Extra 戰前 一索
column4: 為什麼要換那個？
column5: Why would he want that?

column1: Extra 戰前 一索
column4: 他想一個人永遠不輸地守著結界。一個人哪可能永遠不輸？所以我贏了天印，替他好好收著。
column5: He wanted to guard the barrier alone and never lose. How can anyone alone never lose? So I won the seals and kept them safe for him.

column1: Extra 戰前 一索
column4: 所以你一直在等他找人幫忙？
column5: So you've been waiting for him to ask for help?

column1: Extra 戰前 一索
column4: 誰知道呢。規矩是：贏我，十三枚全給你。
column5: Who knows. The rule: beat me and all thirteen are yours.

column1: Extra 戰前 一索
column4: 那再加一桌菜！
column5: Then add a full dinner on top!

column1: Extra 戰前 一索
column4: 行。贏了，就是十三枚天印加十三道菜。輸了，碗歸你洗。
column5: Done. Win, and it's thirteen Heaven Seals and thirteen dishes. Lose, and the dishes are yours to wash.

column1: Extra 戰前 一索
column4: 小朋友，帶著人偶來打牌？
column5: Little one, you brought puppets to a card game?

column1: Extra 戰前 一索
column4: 孩子們說，您的牌在發光。
column5: The children say your tiles are glowing.

column1: Extra 戰前 一索
column4: 好眼光。這十三張，是燁的天印。我替他收了五百年。
column5: Good eye. These thirteen are Yoh's Heaven Seals. I've kept them for him for five hundred years.

column1: Extra 戰前 一索
column4: 燁先生那時想用它們換什麼呢？
column5: What did Yoh want to trade them for back then?

column1: Extra 戰前 一索
column4: 換我的運氣。他想一個人守到永遠，永遠不輸。我不想看他那樣，就贏下了天印。
column5: My luck. He wanted to guard it alone forever and never lose. I didn't want to see him like that, so I won the seals.

column1: Extra 戰前 一索
column4: 您是怕他……一直一個人嗎？
column5: Were you afraid he'd... always be alone?

column1: Extra 戰前 一索
column4: 人偶師，你看得太清楚了。天印很重，我得確定你們拿得動。陪我打一局吧。
column5: You see too clearly, puppeteer. The seals are heavy; I need to be sure you can carry them. Play a game with me.

column1: Extra 戰前 一索
column4: 孩子們，我們坐下吧。
column5: Children, let's sit down.

column1: Extra 戰後 一索
column4: 和了！……不對，是你和了。十三枚天印，拿去。
column5: Mahjong! ...No, wait, you won. The thirteen seals are yours.

column1: Extra 戰後 一索
column4: 就這樣？你不賴帳？
column5: Just like that? No welching?

column1: Extra 戰後 一索
column4: 賭品要好。而且這局，我等了五百年。
column5: A gambler keeps his word. Besides, I've waited five hundred years for this game.

column1: Extra 戰後 一索
column4: 等燁找到可以幫他的人？
column5: Waiting for Yoh to find someone to help him?

column1: Extra 戰後 一索
column4: 你要這麼想也行。天印拿回去，最舊的裂痕也會合上。
column5: Think of it that way if you like. Take the seals back, and the oldest crack will close.

column1: Extra 戰後 一索
column4: 你其實一直在幫他吧。
column5: You've been helping him all along, haven't you.

column1: Extra 戰後 一索
column4: 下次帶他來打牌。三缺一。
column5: Bring him to play next time. We're one short for a table.

column1: Extra 戰後 一索
column4: 漂亮。每一箭都聽牌。
column5: Beautiful. Every shot one tile from winning.

column1: Extra 戰後 一索
column4: 天印。
column5: The seals.

column1: Extra 戰後 一索
column4: 拿去，十三枚，一枚不少。
column5: Here. Thirteen, not one missing.

column1: Extra 戰後 一索
column4: 你早就想還了。
column5: You wanted to give them back all along.

column1: Extra 戰後 一索
column4: 我在等值得還的人。那傢伙終於肯讓別人幫忙了。
column5: I was waiting for someone worth giving them to. That fool finally let someone help him.

column1: Extra 戰後 一索
column4: 你們兩個，都很麻煩。
column5: You two are both a pain.

column1: Extra 戰後 一索
column4: 哈哈！這句我收下。改天來打牌。
column5: Hahaha! I'll take that. Come play sometime.

column1: Extra 戰後 一索
column4: 輸了輸了！說好的，十三枚天印，還有十三道菜！
column5: I lose, I lose! As promised: thirteen Heaven Seals and thirteen dishes!

column1: Extra 戰後 一索
column4: 耶！真的有菜！
column5: Yay! There really is food!

column1: Extra 戰後 一索
column4: 天和閣的廚房可是天界第一。
column5: The Tenhou Pavilion's kitchen is the best in the heavens.

column1: Extra 戰後 一索
column4: 那等燁醒來，也帶他來吃！
column5: Then once Yoh wakes up, I'll bring him here to eat too!

column1: Extra 戰後 一索
column4: 他？他五百年沒踏進這裡了。
column5: Him? He hasn't set foot here in five hundred years.

column1: Extra 戰後 一索
column4: 那就更要來啦，五百年沒吃，一定很餓。
column5: All the more reason. Five hundred years without eating, he must be starving.

column1: Extra 戰後 一索
column4: 你這山伏……好，我把位子留著。
column5: You yamabushi... Fine. I'll keep a seat for him.

column1: Extra 戰後 一索
column4: 你贏了，人偶師。天印請帶回去吧。
column5: You win, puppeteer. Please take the seals back.

column1: Extra 戰後 一索
column4: 孩子們說，您其實很捨不得。
column5: The children say you don't really want to let them go.

column1: Extra 戰後 一索
column4: 陪了我五百年的東西，哪有捨得的。
column5: They've kept me company for five hundred years. Of course I don't.

column1: Extra 戰後 一索
column4: 那您可以去天宮看它們。和燁先生一起。
column5: Then you can visit them at the palace. With Yoh.

column1: Extra 戰後 一索
column4: 你真是溫柔得可怕。好，就這麼說定了。
column5: You're frighteningly kind. All right, it's a deal.

column1: Extra 戰後 一索
column4: 孩子們，回家吧。天印也一起。
column5: Children, let's go home. The seals are coming with us.

column1: Extra-IF 道中 窮奇
column4: 喲，好正直的眼神。我最喜歡吃你這種人了。
column5: Well, what honest eyes. People like you are my favourite meal.

column1: Extra-IF 道中 窮奇
column4: 天宮是你們弄塌的？
column5: Did you lot bring the palace down?

column1: Extra-IF 道中 窮奇
column4: 是結界自己碎的，我們只是出來透透氣。我是窮奇——吵架的時候，我專吃講理的那一邊。
column5: The barrier broke on its own. We just came out for some air. I'm Qiongqi. When people argue, I eat whoever's in the right.

column1: Extra-IF 道中 窮奇
column4: 燁在哪裡！
column5: Where's Yoh!

column1: Extra-IF 道中 窮奇
column4: 上面，和我的兄弟們一起。饕餮、檮杌、混沌。好心勸你：回頭吧，正直的人在上面活不久。
column5: Up there, with my brothers. Taotie, Taowu, Hundun. A friendly warning: turn back. Honest people don't last long up there.

column1: Extra-IF 道中 窮奇
column4: 我才不回頭！
column5: I'm not turning back!

column1: Extra-IF 道中 窮奇
column4: 哈！那就從頭開始，一口一口吃掉你！
column5: Ha! Then I'll start with your head and eat you one bite at a time!

column1: Extra-IF 道中 檮杌
column4: 射手。你也是來把我們壓回去的？
column5: Archer. Have you come to push us back under too?

column1: Extra-IF 道中 檮杌
column4: 結界碎了。你是什麼。
column5: The barrier's broken. What are you?

column1: Extra-IF 道中 檮杌
column4: 檮杌。四神鎮著的四凶之一。不聽教、不回頭——你們人是這麼說我的。
column5: Taowu. One of the Four Perils the Four Gods held down. Won't be taught, won't turn back. That's what you humans say about me.

column1: Extra-IF 道中 檮杌
column4: 燁在哪。
column5: Where's Yoh?

column1: Extra-IF 道中 檮杌
column4: 在上面，倒在我兄弟們中間。饕餮、混沌、窮奇。你去了也沒用。
column5: Up there, fallen among my brothers. Taotie, Hundun, Qiongqi. Going won't help you.

column1: Extra-IF 道中 檮杌
column4: 那就先過你。
column5: Then I'll get past you first.

column1: Extra-IF 道中 檮杌
column4: 好。我也從不退。
column5: Good. I never back down either.

column1: Extra-IF 道中 饕餮
column4: 嗯？好香……你身上有五份力量的味道。
column5: Hm? Something smells good... You smell of five shares of power.

column1: Extra-IF 道中 饕餮
column4: 你是誰？天宮怎麼塌成這樣……燁呢？
column5: Who are you? Why has the palace collapsed like this... Where's Yoh?

column1: Extra-IF 道中 饕餮
column4: 我是饕餮。結界昨晚碎了，那個守護者也倒了。壓在四神底下幾千年，總算能出來吃頓飽的。
column5: I'm Taotie. The barrier broke last night and the guardian fell with it. Thousands of years under the Four Gods, and finally I can eat my fill.

column1: Extra-IF 道中 饕餮
column4: 你在吃什麼？那是天宮的柱子耶！
column5: What are you eating? That's one of the palace's pillars!

column1: Extra-IF 道中 饕餮
column4: 柱子、雲、星星，什麼都能吃。上面還有我的兄弟們——檮杌、混沌、窮奇。回頭吧，他們沒我這麼好說話。
column5: Pillars, clouds, stars, it's all food. My brothers are further up: Taowu, Hundun, Qiongqi. Turn back. They're not as easygoing as me.

column1: Extra-IF 道中 饕餮
column4: 才不要！我要把燁找出來！
column5: No way! I'm going to find Yoh!

column1: Extra-IF 道中 饕餮
column4: 那就比比看，誰的胃口比較大！
column5: Then let's see whose appetite is bigger!

column1: Extra-IF 道中 混沌
column4: 人偶。你帶著好多人偶。
column5: Puppets. You've brought so many puppets.

column1: Extra-IF 道中 混沌
column4: 孩子們說，您沒有臉，可是您在笑。
column5: The children say you have no face, but you're smiling.

column1: Extra-IF 道中 混沌
column4: 我是混沌。沒有眼睛，也看得見你；沒有耳朵，也聽見了結界碎掉的聲音。
column5: I am Hundun. With no eyes, I still see you; with no ears, I still heard the barrier break.

column1: Extra-IF 道中 混沌
column4: 燁先生在哪裡？
column5: Where is Yoh?

column1: Extra-IF 道中 混沌
column4: 他倒下了。四神一倒，我們四個就出來了。兄弟們在上面——饕餮、檮杌、窮奇。
column5: He fell. When the Four Gods fell, the four of us came out. My brothers are above: Taotie, Taowu, Qiongqi.

column1: Extra-IF 道中 混沌
column4: 孩子們想帶燁先生回家。
column5: The children want to take Yoh home.

column1: Extra-IF 道中 混沌
column4: 那就陪我跳一支舞，人偶師。跳完還站得住，就往上走。
column5: Then dance with me, puppeteer. If you're still standing when it ends, go on up.

column1: Extra-IF 戰前 四凶
column4: 來了來了！窮奇說的那個正直小鬼！
column5: Here he comes! The honest brat Qiongqi was talking about!

column1: Extra-IF 戰前 四凶
column4: 打倒了窮奇，還敢往上走。
column5: Beat Qiongqi and still came up.

column1: Extra-IF 戰前 四凶
column4: 你們就是四凶？燁在哪裡！
column5: So you're the Four Perils? Where's Yoh!

column1: Extra-IF 戰前 四凶
column4: 在我們身後。結界碎了，守護者倒在碎片裡。
column5: Behind us. The barrier broke, and the guardian lies among the pieces.

column1: Extra-IF 戰前 四凶
column4: 我說過了吧？正直的人在上面活不久。
column5: Didn't I tell you? Honest people don't last long up here.

column1: Extra-IF 戰前 四凶
column4: 為什麼要出來搗亂！結界壓著你們，山下的人才能好好過日子！
column5: Why come out and wreck everything! The barrier held you down so people below could live in peace!

column1: Extra-IF 戰前 四凶
column4: 我們被壓了幾千年。沒有人問過我們，想不想好好過日子。
column5: We were held down for thousands of years. No one ever asked whether we wanted to live in peace.

column1: Extra-IF 戰前 四凶
column4: 那也不能拿山下的人出氣。
column5: That still doesn't mean you can take it out on the people below.

column1: Extra-IF 戰前 四凶
column4: 所以啊，你身上那五份力量，正好讓我們吃個飽！
column5: So anyway, those five shares of yours will make a nice full meal!

column1: Extra-IF 戰前 四凶
column4: 休想！我一個一個打回去！
column5: Not a chance! I'll beat you back, one at a time!

column1: Extra-IF 戰前 四凶
column4: 好啊，一個一個來。最後，四個一起！
column5: Sure, one at a time. And at the end, all four together!

column1: Extra-IF 戰前 四凶
column4: 你果然上來了。
column5: So you did come up.

column1: Extra-IF 戰前 四凶
column4: 燁在哪。
column5: Where's Yoh?

column1: Extra-IF 戰前 四凶
column4: 哇，好冷的人。檮杌，就是他打贏你？
column5: Wow, what a cold one. Taowu, this is the guy who beat you?

column1: Extra-IF 戰前 四凶
column4: 眼神真直，我喜歡。
column5: Such straight eyes. I like him.

column1: Extra-IF 戰前 四凶
column4: 守護者在後面。四神倒了，結界碎了。你要怎麼做？
column5: The guardian is behind us. The Four Gods have fallen, the barrier is broken. What will you do?

column1: Extra-IF 戰前 四凶
column4: 把你們射回原位。用我身上的五份力量。
column5: Shoot you all back where you belong. With the five shares I carry.

column1: Extra-IF 戰前 四凶
column4: 我們不會退。你也不會。那就只剩一條路。
column5: We won't back down. Neither will you. That leaves only one way.

column1: Extra-IF 戰前 四凶
column4: 我只需要四箭。
column5: I only need four arrows.

column1: Extra-IF 戰前 四凶
column4: 哈哈哈！四箭？那就一箭一箭試試！
column5: Hahaha! Four arrows? Then let's try them one at a time!

column1: Extra-IF 戰前 四凶
column4: 又是你！剛剛還沒吃夠嗎？
column5: You again! Weren't you full yet?

column1: Extra-IF 戰前 四凶
column4: 還沒！我還要找燁！
column5: Not yet! I still have to find Yoh!

column1: Extra-IF 戰前 四凶
column4: 這山伏怎麼回事，一點都不怕。
column5: What's with this yamabushi? Not scared in the slightest.

column1: Extra-IF 戰前 四凶
column4: 他心裡沒有怕，只有餓。
column5: There's no fear in him. Only hunger.

column1: Extra-IF 戰前 四凶
column4: 結界碎了，守護者倒了，我們出來了。你一個人能做什麼？
column5: The barrier's broken, the guardian has fallen, and we're out. What can you do alone?

column1: Extra-IF 戰前 四凶
column4: 把你們打回去，把燁叫起來，然後大家一起吃飯！你們也可以來！
column5: Beat you back, wake Yoh up, and then we all eat together! You can come too!

column1: Extra-IF 戰前 四凶
column4: 這、這是在請我們吃飯？
column5: Is- is he inviting us to dinner?

column1: Extra-IF 戰前 四凶
column4: 先打贏再說吧，小鬼！
column5: Win first, then talk, brat!

column1: Extra-IF 戰前 四凶
column4: 人偶師。你跳完舞了，還站著。
column5: Puppeteer. The dance is over, and you're still standing.

column1: Extra-IF 戰前 四凶
column4: 孩子們都在。
column5: The children are all here.

column1: Extra-IF 戰前 四凶
column4: 哦？混沌居然放他上來？
column5: Oh? Hundun actually let him up here?

column1: Extra-IF 戰前 四凶
column4: 好安靜的小鬼。你不怕嗎？
column5: Such a quiet kid. Aren't you scared?

column1: Extra-IF 戰前 四凶
column4: 怕。可是孩子們說，你們也很寂寞。
column5: I am. But the children say you're lonely too.

column1: Extra-IF 戰前 四凶
column4: 寂寞？被壓在結界底下幾千年，只剩下恨。
column5: Lonely? After thousands of years under the barrier, all that's left is hate.

column1: Extra-IF 戰前 四凶
column4: 那麼，等一切結束，請和燁先生把話說清楚。
column5: Then when this is over, please talk it out with Yoh.

column1: Extra-IF 戰前 四凶
column4: 說話……我們說的話，從來沒有人聽。若你贏了，我們就聽你說。
column5: Talk... No one has ever listened to what we say. If you win, we'll listen to you.

column1: Extra-IF 戰後 四凶
column4: 輸了。正直的人，原來也能活著上來啊。
column5: We lost. So honest people can make it up here alive after all.

column1: Extra-IF 戰後 四凶
column4: 我會把你們封回去。可是這次不是用恨，是用約定。
column5: I'm going to seal you back. But this time not with hate. With a promise.

column1: Extra-IF 戰後 四凶
column4: 約定？
column5: A promise?

column1: Extra-IF 戰後 四凶
column4: 下一次天門之夜，我會上來看你們。不會再讓你們被忘掉。
column5: On the next Night of the Heaven's Gate, I'll come up to see you. I won't let you be forgotten again.

column1: Extra-IF 戰後 四凶
column4: 那、那順便帶點吃的！
column5: Th- then bring some food while you're at it!

column1: Extra-IF 戰後 四凶
column4: 結界重新亮起來了。守護者也快醒了。
column5: The barrier is lighting up again. The guardian will wake soon.

column1: Extra-IF 戰後 四凶
column4: 我退了。第一次。
column5: I backed down. For the first time.

column1: Extra-IF 戰後 四凶
column4: 你沒退。你只是輸了。
column5: You didn't back down. You just lost.

column1: Extra-IF 戰後 四凶
column4: 這兩個有什麼不一樣？
column5: What's the difference?

column1: Extra-IF 戰後 四凶

column5: It was the children dancing. Can we talk now?

column1: 結局

column5: The rain had stopped that very day.

column1: 結局

column1: 結局

column1: 結局

column5: Sou followed the animal trails and brought in the traps he'd left out for days, one after another.

column1: 結局

column1: 結局

column5: He looked at it for a while, then let it go.

column1: 結局

column5: Sou said nothing and held the ladder steady for him.

column1: 結局

column1: 結局

column5: Tied to it was a note with just two words: “Awake yet?”

column5: The owner asked where he'd come from. He thought about it and said, “The sky.”

column1: 結局

column5: On his way back past the Garden of the Four Gentlemen, Mochiku, straight-faced, pushed a basket of bamboo shoots into his hands.

column5: “These are not for you. Take them to the one in the palace.”

column5: So Haru shouldered a lunch box and the shoots and climbed to the Heavenly Palace once more.

column5: “Food doesn't taste good eaten alone. When you wake up, we'll eat together.”

column1: 結局
column4: 下山的時候，晴發現自己第一次不覺得餓。
column5: On the way down, Haru noticed that, for the first time, he wasn't hungry.
